We all have the exact same 168 hours in a week ⏳

If you sleep for 56 hours and spend about 12 hours on essentials like eating, you are left with 100 hours a week to play with.

Think of these as 100 tokens.

Every single choice you make is just a matter of where you choose to allocate those tokens.

The truth is, everything we do involves a sacrifice:

🏋️ Going to the gym? You're sacrificing time with your loved ones.

💻 Working your 9-to-5? You're sacrificing time with your loved ones.

🕹️ Playing video games? You're sacrificing time with your loved ones.

Building a business isn't uniquely evil for taking up your time, it's just another way to spend your tokens.

If you have a full-time job, a family, and want to start a side hustle, something has to give.

The real question we have to ask ourselves is: Are we willing to pay the price?

Sometimes, we choose to sacrifice a bit of time now so we can build the life and freedom we want later.

It's a deliberate choice, not an accident.

How do you choose to spend your 100 tokens each week?

I’m 32, and I’m absolutely still figuring life out.

I have a friend who is 55, and he still feels like he’s figuring it out. Another friend in his 60s feels exactly the same way.

From the outside, these guys have it all - wealth, a wife, kids, a beautiful family. They look completely sorted. Yet internally, they still feel like they’re navigating uncharted territory.

The reality is that life is not something that will ever be "figured out."

There will always be new problems, changes in the tides, and shifts in the wind. There is no final destination where you just hit "cruise control" and coast forever.

Change is the only constant.

But honestly, i’s kind of beautiful that we’re always figuring it out. Otherwise, where would be the fun in it?
